name: moth
_about: A moth -- the generic brown noctuid, the large yellow underwing (Noctua pronuba), 2.5 cm long and 5.5 cm across the wings: at rest the forewings fold back flat and roof-like over the body, brown mottled, with two pale-ringed marks (the round and the kidney stigma), a black dash near the tip and fine wavy cross-lines; the hindwings tucked away beneath are golden yellow bordered black -- a flash when it flies. A furry crested thorax, thread antennae, six legs. Coat: grey (the setaceous form). Written whole by tools/creaturegen/rework/winged/butterflies.py on insectlib.py + wlib.py (each wing one sheet, its upperside's painting laid on it as thin sheets in layers -- the 2D butterflies' own paintings, assets/butterflies/; the wings beat in the variant "flying").
